about_the_game:
BlackPearl is a solo indie horror project. I'm doing my best to make the game the best it can be in every possible way. In my announcements, I regularly share updates on the current progress of the game.

  • Are there better games out there? Yes!

  • Are there projects with a bigger budget? Definitely.

But I’m putting all my creativity and heart into this—my very first game.

I truly hope that everyone who gets it will enjoy playing it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (3GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Explore the abandoned park at night as a lone Ranger. Follow mysterious instructions over the radio, avoid the moving lights, and uncover what lurks between the trees—before it’s too late. The answer might be above you... or buried deeper than you think. A single-player horror experience.
supported_languages:
English*, German, Hungarian
*languages with full audio support
